function.name: send_summary_email
function.description: Send the structured call summary email to the correct brand inbox (GPS or Schendel). Call this at the end of every call after collecting all available information.

concern_description.description: Description of the pest issue or reason for calling

concern_rating.description: Caller concern level 1 to 5 (ask for emergencies)

preferred_appointment.description: Preferred day and time window (morning or afternoon)

service_reminders.description: Reminder preference: text, email, both, or none

intent_tags.description: Classification tags: NEW CUSTOMER, EXISTING CUSTOMER, COMMERCIAL, RESIDENTIAL, BILLING, RESCHEDULE, EMERGENCY, REQUESTED HUMAN, QUOTE ACCEPTED, QUOTE PRESENTED

requested_human.description: True if the caller explicitly asked to speak with a human

summary.description: Brief one sentence summary of the call

notes.description: Any additional notes or edge case info

function.name: detect_brand
function.description: Detect whether the caller issue belongs to GPS Pest or Schendel Lawn based on description keywords.

description.description: The caller's description of their issue

function.name: get_callback_message
function.description: Get the time-aware callback expectation message based on current time of day.

function.name: check_emergency
function.description: Check if the caller's issue qualifies as an emergency based on description and concern rating.

description.description: The caller's description of their issue

function.name: get_quote
function.description: Calculate residential pest control pricing based on bathroom count, program, and cadence. Returns full pricing breakdown with payment options. Only use for residential callers — NEVER for commercial, bed bugs, termites, wildlife, or yard treatments.

bathroom_count.description: Number of bathrooms in the home, e.g. '2', '3.5', '6'

program.description: Which program to quote. Default to 'thrive'.

cadence.description: Service frequency. Default to 'quarterly' for residential.

one_time_pests.description: One-time pest treatment add-ons based on the caller's issue. $100 each.
